cohort: 50 pregnant women infected with COVID-19 admitted to Zagazig Isolation Hospitals, Egypt, who either aborted or were in labor.
finding: Maternal outcome was significantly associated with duration of ICU stay, CT chest result, fetal weight, and gestational age.
gest_age: Varied, but higher gestational age associated with good maternal outcome
birth_weight: Varied, lower birth weight associated with need for NICU admission
